name: Srank Mod Menu
description: Srank Mod Menu: noclip, accuracy, CPS, click indicator, speedhack, auto coins, FPS and unlock all icons.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Don't die when touching hazards or walls.

noclip-accuracy.name: Noclip Accuracy
noclip-accuracy.description: Show the percentage of frames you were NOT touching a hazard.

noclip-min-accuracy.name: Noclip Min Accuracy %
noclip-min-accuracy.description: Die if accuracy drops below this value (0 = never die).

cps-counter.name: CPS Counter
cps-counter.description: Show clicks per second in the top-left.

click-indicator.name: Click Indicator
click-indicator.description: Show a dot at the bottom of the screen that lights up while you hold click.

speed-pitch.name: Speed Affects Music
speed-pitch.description: Change the music pitch together with the speed.

auto-coins.name: Auto Pickup Coins
auto-coins.description: Automatically collect every coin in the level.

fps-enabled.name: FPS Change
fps-enabled.description: Use a custom FPS (turn off VSync in GD's video settings for values above your monitor's refresh rate).

unlock-all.name: Unlock All Icons
unlock-all.description: Unlock every icon and color in the garage (local only).

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Marks the run as a test run whenever noclip, speedhack or auto coins are on, so cheated progress isn't saved or submitted.
